page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Runtime configuration of every Aegis module. Persistent changes go through the Config editor; runtime toggles live on the Security page.
creds.desc.mustChange: You're using installer defaults. Pick a new email + password immediately.
creds.desc.normal: Update the email + password used to sign in to this panel.
creds.err.tooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
runtime.title: Runtime
session.title: Session
danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.desc: Local-only — affects this browser session only
danger.body: Clears the admin token from localStorage. You will be asked to log in again.
ml.scorer.title: ML Scorer
ml.scorer.desc: 23-feature request scorer driving the threat tier on every request. Supports logistic regression and gradient-boosted tree (GBM) model kinds.
ml.scorer.notWired.hint: Enable the ML scorer (and choose the model kind: logistic or GBM) in the runtime configuration.
ml.adversarial.title: Adversarial Mutation Loop
ml.adversarial.desc: Periodically generates SQLi / XSS / command-injection mutations, tests them against the WAF, and feeds bypasses back to the trainer as malicious labels.
ml.honeypot.title: Honeypot
ml.honeypot.notWired.hint: Turn on the honeypot subsystem in the runtime configuration.
feeds.ja4.title: JA4 Reputation
feeds.ja4.desc: JA4 TLS-fingerprint reputation. On by default and self-learning: fingerprints of requests caught by a honeypot / WAF / tarpit are auto-added (entry count grows as attacks arrive). Also loads an optional CrowdSec feed and any operator files. Hot-reloaded on mtime.
feeds.ja4.notWired.hint: Point the JA4 reputation feed at one or more fingerprint list files in the runtime configuration.
feeds.asn.title: ASN / CIDR Reputation
feeds.asn.desc: Hosting, proxy, and Tor-exit reputation. On by default: auto-populated from Tor exit nodes + Spamhaus DROP (refreshed daily). AS-keyed entries match when a GeoIP ASN database is loaded (seeded automatically); CIDR entries always match.
feeds.asn.notWired.hint: Point the ASN reputation feed at a list file in the runtime configuration.
infra.restart.title: Restart required.
infra.restart.before: One or more settings were saved to the runtime configuration. Apply the change below or restart the Aegis service manually.
infra.cache.title: Response Cache
infra.cache.desc: In-memory response cache for upstream replies. Reduces backend load on cacheable routes. Requires restart to enable or disable.
infra.cache.label: Response cache
infra.trust.title: Dynamic Trust
infra.trust.desc: Behavioural trust scoring — upgrades verified clients to a lower-friction tier over time. Requires restart to take effect.
infra.trust.label: Dynamic trust
infra.fw.title: Firewall Backend
infra.fw.desc.before: Kernel firewall driver for IP-level block and deny actions.
infra.fw.desc.after: selects the best available driver at startup (XDP → nftables → iptables → noop). Requires restart to take effect.
infra.fw.label: Firewall backend
infra.xdp.title: XDP Fast-path
infra.xdp.desc: Linux kernel L4 filter. Per-IP deny lists, rate limiting, and SYN-flood guard are applied before userspace sees the packet.
infra.xdp.body.before: Live state visible on the Security page or via
infra.acme.title: ACME Auto-cert
infra.acme.desc: Automatic TLS certificate provisioning via ACME protocol
infra.acme.notWired.hint: Connect an ACME client to enable automatic certificate provisioning.
infra.crowdsec.title: CrowdSec LAPI
infra.crowdsec.desc: Exposes Aegis decisions in CrowdSec-bouncer-compatible wire format for nginx, HAProxy, and Kubernetes ingress downstream enforcement.
infra.crowdsec.notWired.hint: Expose the CrowdSec-compatible HTTP route on your deployment. The data adapter is ready.
infra.clamav.title: ClamAV Scanner
infra.clamav.desc: Antivirus file scanning integration via clamd socket
infra.clamav.notWired.hint: Set the clamd address in the runtime configuration to enable antivirus scanning.
